"''Bring peace and prosperity to the galaxy, install a regime loyal to the Emperor, and eradicate the hostiles.''"
"''It's their planet, we're the hostiles.|Han Solo and Alayus Bolandin discuss the Empire's objectives on Mimban|}} '''Alayus Bolandin''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[lieutenant]] in the [[224th Imperial Armored Division]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Mimban Campaign]]. Following the [[death]] of [[Major]] [[Staz]], Bolandin was given a field promotion to the [[military rank]] of [[captain]] by [[General]] [[Ire Falk|Falk]]. A veteran, he regarded [[Corporal]] [[Han Solo]] as a troublemaker, and when Solo was captured as an alleged deserter, Bolandin ordered him to be fed to "[[Chewbacca|the beast]]." ==Biography== {{Quote|Attention! In three hours, we move out to the southern marshlands. I want an advance party of ten men.''"
"''Great, more mud.''"
"''What was that?|Alayus Bolandin and a rebellious Han Solo|}} Alayus Bolandin was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as an [[Imperial officer]] in the [[224th Imperial Armored Division]] of the [[Imperial Army]] and the [[Imperial Officer Corps]].''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' By [[10 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' dates the [[Mimban Campaign]] to nine [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]. Therefore the [[Mimban]] campaign must take place in [[10 BBY]]. he was a veteran{{Databank|lieutenant-bolandin|Lieutenant Bolandin}} with the rank of [[lieutenant]] stationed on the [[planet]] [[Mimban]], where the [[Galactic Empire]] was [[Mimban Campaign|fighting]] the [[Mimbanese]] natives over [[mining]] the world's heavy mineral deposits. After [[Major]] [[Staz]] perished during the fighting, Bolandin took over command of the 224th at [[Imperial Forward Field Operations|Camp Forward]]. Bolandin called the [[Imperial Military|forces]] in the camp to attention and announced that they would be moving out to the [[Southern Marshlands]] in three [[Standard hour|hours]] and that he wanted to send an advance party of ten men ahead of them. In response to the announcement, [[Corporal]] [[Han Solo]] mutter sarcastically about heading to a location with more mud and caught Bolandin's attention. The lieutenant asked Solo to repeat himself, but the corporal instead questioned their objectives. Bolandin listed what he saw as the Empire's aims on Mimban, and, after another snarky comment from Solo, approached the corporal menacingly to ask if there was a problem. Solo backed down and replied in the negative, after which Bolandin dispersed the gathering. Bolandin was later talking to a group of other [[officer]]s and two [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|TIE pilots]] by the [[Camp Forward airfield]] when he was summoned over by [[Tobias Beckett]], a criminal disguised as an Imperial [[captain]]. Beckett informed the lieutenant that he and his companions had caught a deserter, and presented Solo, who had been trying to blackmail his way into [[Beckett's gang]]. Bolandin accepted the lie and told his men to feed Solo to "the beast," a nickname given to [[Chewbacca]], a [[Wookiee]] prisoner being held at Camp Forward. Bolandin was then given a field promotion to captain by [[General]] [[Ire Falk|Falk]] before redeploying to the Southern Marshlands. ==Personality and traits== {{Dialogue|Beckett|Lieutenant.|Bolandin|Captain.|Beckett|Lieutenant, we have apprehended a deserter. Take him.|Solo|That's… wait.|Bolandin|I should've known. This one's a troublemaker.|attr=Tobias Beckett turns Han Solo over to Lieutenant Bolandin|src=}} Alayus Bolandin was unerringly loyal to the Galactic Empire, and believed the objectives of the Imperial forces on Mimban was to bring peace and prosperity to [[the galaxy]] and effect regime change on the world to a group loyal to the [[Galactic Emperor]] by eradicating the enemy. Having long regarded Solo as a troublemaker with a big [[mouth]] and believing that his men already had enough problems to deal with, Bolandin readily accept Beckett's deceitful claim that Solo was a deserter. Bolandin stood 1.88 [[meter]]s tall and had light skin, [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], and blue [[eye]]s. ==Equipment== On Mimban, Bolandin wore a gray [[Imperial kepi]] with an [[officer's disk]] as well as a gray [[greatcoat]] with a brown fur collar that also bore his [[rank insignia plaque]], which showed two red pips and one blue. Under the coat he wore an [[armor]] breastplate that also bore the plaque and a brown neck guard. He also wore a brown [[belt]] with four pouches attached, black [[boot]]s and black [[glove]]s. ==Behind the scenes== Alayus Bolandin was portrayed by [[Hal Fowler]] in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology Series]] film, ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', who was credited as only "Mimban Lieutenant." The character was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and provided the surname Bolandin.''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' The [[2021]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' then established his first name as Alayus. ==Appearances== *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' {{1st}} *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition]]'' {{Ab|Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition (audiobook)}} *[[Solo: A Star Wars Story Adaptation 1|''Solo: A Star Wars Story Adaptation'' 1]] ==Sources== *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' {{1stID|Bolandin}} *''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' {{1stID|Alayus}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Core Worlds, Colonies, the Inner Rim and Expansion Region}} *{{Databank|lieutenant-bolandin|Lieutenant Bolandin}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Alayus Bolandin |fr=Alayus Bolandin |ja=アレイユス・ボランディン |ka=ალაიუს ბოლანდინი |tr=Alayus Bolandin |uk=Алаюс Боландін }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Bolandin, Alayus}} [[Category:224th Imperial Armored Division personnel]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Army officers of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Males]]
